description: This file defines a class CommonMarkConverter that extends a base Markdown converter, customizing environment extensions and configuration for handling Markdown content with specific features like table of contents, heading permalinks, and rendering of specific node types.

classes.name: CommonMarkConverter
classes.description: A PHP class extending a Markdown converter to integrate specific environment extensions and rendering customizations for Markdown processing.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the converter with custom configuration for heading permalinks and table of contents, passing it to the parent constructor.

methods.name: extendEnvironment
methods.description: Method to extend the Markdown environment with additional extensions and renderers specific to headings, TOC, fenced code blocks, and images.
